title: APD Gauntlet shared schema definitions
description: Reusable $defs for patterns referenced across multiple record schemas. Edit here; other schemas $ref into this file rather than duplicating the regex.

attack_technique_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID; accepts both top-level (T1078) and sub-technique (T1078.001) forms.

attack_technique_id_topline.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID at top-level only (no sub-technique). Used where the schema author wants to constrain to parent techniques and carry the sub_technique value in a sibling field.

attack_sub_technique_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK sub-technique ID (e.g. T1078.001). Nullable so callers can record 'no sub-technique applicable' explicitly.

attack_mitigation_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK enterprise mitigation ID (e.g. M1041).

d3fend_id.description: MITRE D3FEND short code. Real D3FEND data uses 2-to-7 letter codes (e.g. D3-NTA, D3-NTSA, D3-PHDURA).

atlas_technique_id.description: MITRE ATLAS technique ID; accepts both top-level (AML.T0051) and sub-technique (AML.T0051.000) forms.

maswe_id.description: OWASP MAS Weakness Enumeration ID (e.g. MASWE-0001). Always zero-padded to four digits.

masvs_control_id.description: OWASP MASVS v2 control ID: a category prefix plus a 1-based control ordinal (e.g. MASVS-STORAGE-1).

masvs_category_id.description: OWASP MASVS v2 control category (e.g. MASVS-STORAGE), without a control ordinal.

severity.description: Canonical APD severity tier. 'informational' is the canonical DATA token used in every stored record. The report TEMPLATE's display token is the short form 'info' (CSS classes / sort keys); the data->display mapping is owned solely by tools/apd_gauntlet/severity.py (so metrics.schema.json — a report-facing rollup — enums 'info' by design). Never write 'info' into a pipeline record.

ordinal_level.description: Three-level ordinal scale reused by several DISTINCT concepts (confidence, feasibility, priority, extraction_confidence). $ref this for the shared SCALE; the field keeps its own name for its meaning.

apd_goal.description: One of the nine APD security goals (three per tier).

apd_tier.description: One of the three APD tiers.

disposition.description: A FINDING's disposition — what kind of finding it is. Distinct from cluster-decisions' decision field (merge/link/separate): different record type, different field, no shared namespace.
